name: MIS, Inc. Design System
description: Design system for the 2026 MIS, Inc. site: warm 'paper on a desk' layout, Albuquerque earth tones drawn from the MIS globe logo, an editorial serif/sans type pairing, and restrained motion. Built for Astro + Tailwind CSS v4.
changelog: 2.0.0 — Rebuilt from the approved home page prototype. Palette re-anchored to the actual logo colors (#a62025 / #ff9902) replacing the lighter #9B3139 / #D64F2A pair. Added Fraunces as the display face; headings moved from font-light 300 to bold 700 serif. Replaced the vibrant three-stop Santa Fe page background with a subtle warm gradient so the paper sheet and its shadow read properly. Added marquee, FAQ accordion, card-link, mobile nav, AI badge, map, and ribbon components. Added motion tokens with a reduced-motion contract. Dropped the unused turquoise accent.

tailwind.note: Tailwind v4 defines theme tokens in CSS via @theme, not tailwind.config.js. The `theme` block below maps 1:1 onto @theme custom properties — see `usage.tailwindV4Setup`.

primary.description: Brick red from the MIS globe logo. Headings accents, eyebrows, links, CTA band.

accent.description: Logo gold/orange. Buttons, list bullets, focus rings, timeline highlights.

ink.description: Warm brown text ramp. `ink` for headings, `soft` for body, `muted` for labels and captions.

paper.description: The sheet and the surfaces on it. `panel` for cards, `surface` for chips/step markers, `tint` for banded sections.

ground.description: The desk the paper sits on. Used only by the fixed page backdrop.

line.description: Hairlines. Red-tinted for section rules, brown-tinted for card borders.

fontVariationSettings.note: Fraunces is a variable font. Keep WONK at 0 — the wonky axis reads as decorative at display sizes.

screens.note: lg is 900px, not the Tailwind default 1024px — it is the nav/grid breakpoint used throughout (hero, cards, eras, footer all collapse there).

backdrop.description: Fixed gradient layer behind everything. MUST be a fixed pseudo-element, not background-attachment: fixed — that breaks compositing on long pages and is ignored by iOS Safari.
backdrop.css: position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(255,246,226,.95) 0%, rgba(255,246,226,0) 58%), linear-gradient(165deg, #f8eed9 0%, #efe0c2 45%, #e2cb9f 100%);

sheet.description: The paper. The signature element of the design — everything else sits on it.
sheet.classes: max-w-sheet mx-auto my-6 lg:my-7 bg-paper border border-primary/20 rounded-lg shadow-paper overflow-hidden

wrap.description: Inner content column on the sheet.

ribbon.description: Announcement bar at the very top of the sheet. Keep the copy evergreen — no countable year that goes stale.
ribbon.classes: bg-primary text-[#ffe9d2] text-center text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-ribbon py-2.5 px-4

container.classes: sticky top-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-between gap-6 px-6 md:px-10 py-3.5 border-b border-line bg-paper/90 backdrop-blur-[10px]

menuItem.classes: font-sans font-bold text-[15px] text-ink-soft no-underline hover:text-primary

burger.description: Shown below lg (900px). Animates to an X via aria-expanded.
burger.classes: hidden max-lg:flex w-11 h-11 items-center justify-center bg-transparent border border-line rounded-sm cursor-pointer

mobilePanel.classes: fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-[min(84vw,340px)] z-[70] bg-paper border-l border-line shadow-panel pt-24 px-7 pb-7 flex flex-col gap-1.5 translate-x-full transition-transform duration-panel data-[open]:translate-x-0

mobileLink.classes: font-display text-[22px] font-semibold text-ink no-underline py-3 border-b border-line-soft

scrim.classes: fixed inset-0 z-[65] bg-ink/45 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-panel data-[open]:opacity-100

primary.description: Gold pill. The single most important action on any page.
primary.classes: inline-block font-sans font-extrabold text-[15px] text-white bg-accent px-5 py-3 rounded-full shadow-button no-underline transition hover:bg-accent-dark hover:-translate-y-px

ghost.classes: inline-block font-sans font-extrabold text-[15px] text-primary bg-transparent px-5 py-3 rounded-full border-[1.5px] border-primary/35 no-underline transition hover:bg-primary/5

eyebrow.description: Small red uppercase label above every section heading. Always sans, never serif.
eyebrow.classes: font-sans text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-label text-primary

service.classes: flex flex-col gap-3.5 bg-paper-panel border border-line-soft rounded-lg p-7 shadow-card transition hover:-translate-y-[3px] hover:shadow-cardHover

cardLink.description: Required on every service card — each card must lead somewhere.
cardLink.classes: mt-auto pt-1.5 font-sans text-[15px] font-extrabold text-primary no-underline inline-flex items-center gap-2 [&_.arrow]:transition-transform group-hover:[&_.arrow]:translate-x-1

work.classes: flex flex-col rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-line-soft bg-paper-panel transition hover:-translate-y-[3px] hover:shadow-cardHover

note.classes: flex flex-col gap-2.5 p-6 border border-line-soft rounded-lg bg-paper-panel no-underline text-ink transition hover:-translate-y-[3px] hover:shadow-cardHover

facts.description: Banded stat strip. Numbers animate with count-up on first view.
facts.value: block font-display text-[32px] font-bold text-primary tabular-nums
facts.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-label text-ink-muted

marquee.description: Auto-scrolling platform partner strip. CRITICAL: use overflow-x-hidden + overflow-y-visible with vertical padding — plain overflow-hidden clips the pill hover lift.
marquee.track: flex w-max gap-3.5 py-1 animate-[slide_38s_linear_infinite] hover:[animation-play-state:paused]
marquee.pill: flex items-center gap-2.5 py-2.5 pl-3.5 pr-5 border border-line-soft rounded-full bg-paper-panel no-underline font-bold text-[15px] text-ink-soft whitespace-nowrap transition hover:border-primary/40 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:text-primary
marquee.note: Duplicate the track's children in JS for a seamless loop and mark the copies aria-hidden.

timeline.description: Horizontal era timeline (1995 → 2026). Collapses to a vertical rail below lg. Numbering here is meaningful — it is a real chronology, not decoration.
timeline.container: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-5 border-t-2 border-primary max-lg:border-t-0 max-lg:border-l-2
timeline.year: block font-display text-[23px] font-bold text-primary tabular-nums
timeline.dot: absolute w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-paper border-[3px] border-primary

steps.description: Numbered process list. Uses CSS counters.
steps.marker: grid place-items-center w-[38px] h-[38px] rounded-full bg-paper-surface text-primary font-display font-bold text-base

faq.description: Native <details>/<summary> accordion — works without JS and is crawlable. Pair with FAQPage JSON-LD for AEO.
faq.summary: list-none cursor-pointer py-4 pr-10 relative font-display text-[19px] font-semibold text-ink hover:text-primary
faq.chevron: absolute right-2 top-1/2 w-[11px] h-[11px] -mt-[7px] border-r-[2.5px] border-b-[2.5px] border-primary rotate-45 transition-transform open:rotate-[-135deg]

ctaBand.classes: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-7 rounded-lg px-8 md:px-12 py-10 md:py-14 bg-gradient-to-br from-primary to-primary-dark text-[#fff3de]

footer.columns: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr_1fr] gap-10 px-6 md:px-10 pt-11 pb-8
footer.heading: font-sans text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-label text-ink-muted mb-3
footer.bar: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3.5 border-t border-line px-6 md:px-10 pt-4.5 pb-6 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-muted
footer.copyright: © 1995–{currentYear} Multimedia Internet Services, Inc. All rights reserved.

aiBadge.description: Cross-brand link to the AI practice. Always written 'MIS, Inc. AI' — never 'MIS.ai' or 'misinc.ai' as a display name. Footer only; in the header it competes with the primary logo.
aiBadge.classes: inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 py-2 pl-2 pr-4 border border-line rounded-full bg-paper-panel no-underline leading-tight transition hover:border-primary/40

map.description: Static OpenStreetMap tiles, click-through to Google Maps. Chosen over a Google Maps iframe: no third-party cookies, no consent banner, no render-blocking script, and it costs nothing.
map.classes: block relative h-[190px] rounded-md overflow-hidden border border-line-soft

typography.principle: Fraunces (serif) for anything that is a heading or a number worth noticing. Manrope (sans) for everything a person reads or clicks: body copy, labels, buttons, nav, lists. Never set body copy in the display face.

textStyles.hero: font-display text-4xl font-bold tracking-display text-ink text-balance
textStyles.h2: font-display text-3xl font-bold tracking-display text-ink text-balance
textStyles.label: font-sans text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-label text-ink-muted
textStyles.eyebrow: font-sans text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-label text-primary

smartQuotes.note: All visible copy uses typographic quotes and apostrophes (’ “ ”), never ' or ". Enforce with a remark plugin (remark-smartypants) on markdown content and by hand in components.

motion.principle: Motion should confirm that something is alive, then get out of the way. Every effect below is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

heroTypewriter.description: Hero headline types itself with a blinking caret, then the caret disappears.

scrollReveal.description: Sections fade up as they enter view, staggered within a group.

countUp.description: Stat numbers count from 0 on first view.

motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reveals render visible with no transition, the typewriter prints the full headline immediately, count-ups show final values, the marquee stops and wraps to a static centered row, hover lifts are removed, and smooth scrolling is disabled.

rules: Every interactive element has a visible focus state — the gold outline above.
The mobile panel closes on Escape, on scrim click, and on link activation; aria-expanded tracks state on the burger.
Decorative SVGs and duplicated marquee items are aria-hidden.
Body text sits at ink-soft (#6b4a1e) on paper (#fff7ea) — 7.4:1. Never drop body copy to ink-muted, which passes for large text and labels only.
Guard optional DOM lookups in shared scripts; one missing element must not throw and kill every other behavior on the page.

designPrinciples.layout: A sheet of warm paper resting on a desk. The gradient backdrop exists so the sheet's shadow has something to fall on — keep it subtle; if the backdrop competes with the sheet, it is wrong.
designPrinciples.typography: An editorial serif against a clean sans. The serif carries 31 years of craft; the sans keeps it modern and readable. Headings are bold, not light — this is a company with a track record, and the type should sound certain.
designPrinciples.color: Taken from the MIS globe logo, not invented: brick red and gold on warm cream and brown. Spend boldness on the red and gold; keep every surface around them quiet.
designPrinciples.motion: Three moments carry the page — the headline typing, sections rising into view, and the numbers counting up. Everything else is a 180ms hover. Resist adding a fourth.
designPrinciples.structure: Structural devices must encode something true. The era timeline is a real chronology and earns its numbering; the process steps are a real sequence. Do not number things that are merely a list.
designPrinciples.proof: Prefer a modest true outcome over an impressive invented one. Client testimonials come from the Portfolio CMS with the client named; stats are verifiable facts (founded 1995, 31 years, 500+ projects, 20+ year client relationships).

usage.stack: Astro 5 + Tailwind CSS v4, static output, deployed to Cloudflare Pages.
usage.fonts: Self-host both faces as woff2 in /public/fonts and declare @font-face locally. Do not link Google Fonts — it costs a third-party connection and leaks visitor IPs.
